svg.title: Winnie the Agent data flow
svg.desc: Attackers connect to the SSH honeypot and the protocol traps, which write one event log. An hourly agents pipeline reads the log and runs triage, respond, digest, tune, detect and an optional export to S3. Its outputs are reports, per-source state, notifications, an approval queue, the overlay file and detection drafts. Enforcement happens only after the operator approves. The overlay and per-source state feed back to the front-ends read-only.

text.tspan: SIP FTP Telnet SMTP HTTP S3 Redis
Front-ends only write events. Agents never talk to attackers. Models get no tools.
Nothing outside the honeypot changes without the operator's approval.
